description: This file defines the Product entity class in an e-commerce system, including its fields, relationships, and annotations for persistence with JPA/Hibernate.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: A JPA entity representing a product in the catalog, with fields for descriptions, attributes, images, relationships, and various product properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns audit information for the product.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets audit information for the product.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Returns the primary product description, if available.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Returns the default image for the product, if available.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the collection of product descriptions.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the collection of product attributes.

methods.name: setAvatar
methods.description: Sets the product's images.

methods.name: setCategories
methods.description: Sets the categories associated with the product.

methods.name: setManufacturer
methods.description: Sets the manufacturer for the product.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the product type.

methods.name: setTaxClass
methods.description: Sets the tax class for the product.

methods.name: setAvailabilities
methods.description: Sets the product's availability records.

methods.name: setImages
methods.description: Sets the product images.

methods.name: setRelationships
methods.description: Sets product relationships.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates the product with a merchant store.

methods.name: setDateAvailable
methods.description: Sets the date when the product becomes available.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display sort order.

methods.name: setAvailable
methods.description: Sets whether the product is available.

methods.name: setProductShipeable
methods.description: Sets whether the product is shippable.

methods.name: setProductIsFree
methods.description: Sets whether the product is free.

methods.name: setProductLength
methods.description: Sets the product length.

methods.name: setProductWidth
methods.description: Sets the product width.

methods.name: setProductHeight
methods.description: Sets the product height.

methods.name: setProductWeight
methods.description: Sets the product weight.

methods.name: setProductReviewAvg
methods.description: Sets the average review score.

methods.name: setProductReviewCount
methods.description: Sets the number of reviews.

methods.name: setProductOrdered
methods.description: Sets the ordered quantity.

methods.name: setSku
methods.description: Sets the SKU identifier.
